origin.description: Replaces knitr output hooks and writes a STYLE block. It does not import knitr. The hooks object only needs get and set.
origin.usage: set_knit_hooks(hooks, which = "output", proc.fun = function(x, class) html_code_block(x, class = class), class = sprintf("fansi fansi-%s", which), style = getOption("fansi.css", dflt_css()), split.nl = FALSE, .test = FALSE)
origin.details: Replaces knitr output hooks and writes a STYLE block. It does not import knitr. The hooks object only needs get and set.
origin.value: A character vector, or the previous hooks for set_knit_hooks.
origin.example:
box <- new.env()
box$output <- function(x, options) "old-output"
hooks <- list(
  get = function(name) box[[name]],
  set = function(...) invisible(NULL)
)
old <- set_knit_hooks(hooks)
writeLines(old$output("z", NULL))

translation.description: Replaces knitr output hooks and writes a STYLE block. It does not import knitr. The hooks object only needs get and set.
translation.usage: set_knit_hooks(hooks, which="output", proc_fun=None, class_=None, style=None, split_nl=False)
translation.details: Replaces knitr output hooks and writes a STYLE block. It does not import knitr. The hooks object only needs get and set. A string is one element. None is a missing string. class is written class_.
translation.value: A list of strings, or a dict of the previous hooks for set_knit_hooks.
